chunks: And Abān narrated from Zurārah, who said:
I said to him: A fish leapt up, then fell onto dry land, and thrashed about until it died—may I eat it?

key_terms.ارْتَفَعَتْ: leapt up or rose out of the water

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat a fish that jumps out of the water and dies on dry land?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a fish that exits the water on its own and dies after falling onto dry land. The Imam عليه السلام permits eating it, indicating its permissibility in this case within the laws of hunting and slaughtering.
